_comment: Three awakening stages of one monster (Fairy 10101 / Elucia 10111 / Elucia 2A 10131),
deliberately split across locations: one in Inventory, one in Monster Storage, one in
the Sealed Shrine. The Location filter must be able to hide any of them while the
'Only show if' conditions still see the Lv. 40 max-skilled copy that sits in Storage.
'Have >=' counts one form, so each stage here is held once (ACCOUNT-TABLES.md 4.1).
10132 is a Fire sibling: a different monster, so it must never join that tally.
It is Lv. 40 and max-skilled on purpose. 'All lvl 40 of this family max skilled' is a
family-wide question, and an element sibling is in the family, so one unskilled Lv. 40
copy anywhere would fail the condition for all of them and hide what the test is about.
